_doc: Missions. map = citymap.js options (seed + district). waves: at (s after drop), kind, count, from ('edge' = the district's road ends, 'nest', or {x,z}), spread, every (repeat), until, elite (chance). objectives: kill / killAll / destroy (lots by index into the generated map's biggest lots of a recipe: pickLots) / survive / reach. optional objectives raise the grade. par.time = the time an A-grade run takes. pay = base pay. tier = loot tier (1 early … 5 late). length = 'short' 4-8 min | 'mid' 8-15 | 'long' 15+. comms = lines said in-world (who + text + when). night = time of day, 0 noon … 1 deep night.

missions.name: Drop Zone
missions.brief: The swarm has broken into the Glasswell business district. Drop in, clear the streets, get out.

comms.text: Frame, you're over Glasswell. Doors open in three. Swarm's thick on the east avenues.
Fuel depots on your map will go up if you hit them. Use that.
Big contacts moving in. Armoured fronts — get round behind them.
Dropship's on the pad, north-east corner. Come home.

missions.name: Fuel Line
missions.brief: A rival company is pumping our refineries dry. Burn their three tank farms before the convoy leaves.

comms.text: Three refineries, marked on your map. They're full. Stand well back when they blow.
They've brought rocket artillery. Watch the ground for the red circles.
Smoke's visible from orbit. Nice work. Pick-up's at the north-east lot.

missions.name: Hold the Line
missions.brief: Evacuation trains are leaving the Kettle Row station. Keep the swarm off it until the last one is out.

objectives.label: Hold until the last train leaves

comms.text: Nine minutes, Frame. The trains don't stop for anything.
Swollen ones coming in. Don't let them reach you — pop them at range.
Ground's moving under the station. Something's digging.
Last train's boarding. This is everything they've got.
